_comment: Plain-language explanations written by reading each ability's Java source, used only where the mod's lang file has no description. The extractor flags an entry when its source file changes so it can be re-checked. Keys are ability ids; '_physical_enhancements' covers every physical_enhancements_* passive.
_physical_enhancements: Always-on bodily improvements that grow with every Sequence. The mod constantly recalculates them for your current Sequence and applies them either as attribute bonuses (extra max health, movement speed, attack damage, knockback resistance and so on) or as hidden effects such as night vision, regeneration, fire resistance or water breathing. The exact bonuses for each Sequence are listed in the field notes below and on each Sequence's "Body at this Sequence" line.
criminal_proficiency_ability: While you hold a sword, axe, trident, bow, crossbow or mace in your main hand, you gain +1 Strength enhancement (+3 attack damage).
curse_resistance_ability: Changes how much damage you take from curses cast by others, based on the Sequence gap. Each Sequence you are above the caster cuts the damage by 25% (four or more Sequences above makes you immune). The rule also works in reverse: each Sequence the caster is above you increases the damage by 25%.
demon_of_the_body_ability: A permanent boost to your demonic body: +1 Resistance and +3 Health enhancement levels (+12 max health) on top of your normal physical enhancements.
devil_bloodline_ability: Decides which devil bloodline you carry: Shadow Shifter, Phantom, Shapeshifter, Curseling, Corroder or Flame Devil. The bloodline is picked once from the world seed and your player ID, so it never changes. It unlocks that bloodline's own abilities. At Sequence 0 you hold every bloodline at once.
domain_of_body_ability: Your body heals itself: you regenerate 1 heart every second. Being hit by purification damage stops this regeneration for 40 seconds. When you take damage, every creature within 16 blocks, allies included, suffers a corrosive backlash of 3 damage and a sanity hit, capped at 15% sanity per backlash. The backlash can happen at most once every 20 seconds.
feather_fall_ability: You drift instead of plummeting. As soon as you have fallen more than 2 blocks, you get Slow Falling II, which keeps you from taking fall damage.
fire_resistance_ability: Whenever fire or burning damages you, the flames on you are put out immediately, so you never keep burning.
fire_resistance_abyss_ability: Reduces damage from fire abilities cast by other Beyonders, based on the Sequence gap. Each Sequence you are above the caster cuts the damage by 25%, and four or more Sequences above makes you immune. Each Sequence the caster is above you instead increases it by 25%.
flaming_hit_ability: Whenever you damage a creature, whether with a weapon or an ability, it is set on fire, adding 2.5 seconds to its burn time.
malice_authority_ability: Softens the damage you take from losing control: at Sequence 2 you take only 50% of it, and at Sequence 1 you take 75%. At Sequence 0 there is no reduction.
passive_calamity_attraction_ability: Disaster follows you. At Sequence 6, a random calamity (a tornado, an earthquake or a meteor) strikes somewhere within 6 blocks of you every 20 to 90 seconds. Your action bar warns you about 12 seconds before it lands. Once you advance past Sequence 6 it stops.
poison_resistance_ability: Poison is removed from you as soon as it is applied, so you are effectively immune to it.
sin_lord_ability: You weigh on the souls of killers. Every player within 16 blocks who has at least 50 kills on record slowly loses sanity while near you. Kills count player kills, plus 1 for every 40 villagers and 1 for every 20 Beyonder NPCs. The drain grows with their kill count. It only affects players with no more kills than you, and spares Abyss Beyonders of Sequence 2 or lower and Sun Beyonders of Sequence 4 or lower.
spirit_world_awareness_ability: While you are in the Spirit World, your action bar always shows the matching Overworld coordinates of where you are standing.
void_immunity_ability: You take no damage from falling out of the world, unless you fall deeper than Y = -1000.
word_immunity_abyss_ability: Nausea and Blindness cannot affect you. They are blocked when applied and removed if you already have them.
death_decree_ability: Pronounce death on a creature within 3 blocks. A target two or more Sequences weaker than you dies instantly. A target at your own Sequence receives a death mark instead, and the third mark kills them. A target that is stronger than you, or only one Sequence weaker, resists and loses half of its maximum health as damage that ignores armor. Marks are cleared by death or by a stronger Beyonder's purification. The ability fails inside a stronger purification area.
death_envoy_ability: Release a wave of death around you (5-block radius). Every creature caught in it that is not two or more Sequences stronger than you gets Weakness II and Slowness III for 20 seconds and is frozen solid. They are also Spirit Called (level III) for 5 seconds: rooted in place, unable to use items, taking repeated damage, and unable to use abilities if they are Sequence 7 or weaker. All damage they take ignores armor.
death_flame_ability: Breathe pale death-flame for 10 seconds in a cone 16 blocks long that widens to 5 blocks. Everything inside takes continuous damage that ignores the usual invulnerability frames and is set on fire. With griefing enabled, the flame also sets the ground alight.
death_spells_ability: Two death spells. Withering Wind: a wind of souls rolls forward for 4 seconds, damaging everything within 9 blocks of its path. With griefing enabled, it turns the ground it passes into soul soil and basalt. Soul Siphon: latch onto a creature within 20 blocks for 3 seconds, damaging it five times per second and healing yourself 1.5 health per hit. It breaks if the target moves more than 25 blocks away.
divination_ability: Several divination rites in one ability. Danger Premonition warns you of incoming threats. Structure Divination and Biome Divination point you to a chosen structure or biome. Player Divination locates another player, but cannot find players who are concealed, invisible to Visionary powers, or protected against divination. Anti-Divination is listed as a mode, but its code currently only plays a chime.
divine_kingdom_ability: Raise the Kingdom of Death: a sphere with a 120-block radius that lasts 2 minutes. Inside it, enemy projectiles are destroyed. Every enemy has its Beyonder power cut to 70% (lower the weaker they are) and loses 15 durability per second on all equipment. Each enemy also gets a countdown of 45 seconds, 5 seconds shorter for every Sequence they are below you, and dies when it reaches zero. Enemies two or more Sequences weaker die at once. The kingdom collapses if you die or if a stronger holy purification reaches it.
door_to_the_underworld_ability: Open a gate to the underworld in front of you for 20 seconds. Spirits: every 4 seconds the gate releases an undead (zombie, skeleton, husk, drowned or stray) and a spirit, which all fight for you and vanish after 60 seconds. Tentacles: the gate lashes everything within 6.5 blocks in front of it, twice a second. Using either mode while a gate is open closes it. Release dismisses everything you summoned.
dream_traversal_ability: Travel through dreams. Jump teleports you to the creature you are looking at; until you reach Sequence 3, the target must be asleep. Jump in Range lets you pick any player within reach and teleport to them. Reach grows with your Sequence: 250 blocks at Sequence 5, then 500, 1,000, 7,500, 15,000 and 200,000 blocks at Sequence 0. It fails while your mind world is sealed.
endpoint_ability: Mark a creature within 5 blocks with the Endpoint. A marked creature cannot regain health by any means, including potions, regeneration, revival abilities and direct healing. Milk does not remove the mark; only death or a stronger Beyonder's purification does.
enslavement_ability: Bind a creature within 20 blocks as your slave. It must be weaker than you and on the Death pathway, unless you are Sequence 1 or stronger, in which case any pathway works. You can hold one slave at a time. Seal Abilities stops your slave from using any abilities. Kill destroys it outright. Release frees it. A slave can never damage you or your allies.
eye_of_death_ability: A toggled sight. You gain night vision and see the name and health bar of whatever you look at within 40 blocks. Ghost Beyonders you look at glow for you. Your attacks deal 35% more damage to undead and spirits. It switches off inside a stronger purification area.
hand_of_death_ability: While active, your melee hits carry death. Each hit adds bonus damage equal to 30% of the target's maximum health, plus 10% for every Sequence the target is below you and minus 10% for every Sequence above. Targets three or more Sequences stronger take no bonus. It switches off inside a stronger purification area.
hand_of_life_ability: Restore life. Right Hand - Self heals you for 25% of your maximum health. Right Hand - Others heals the creature you are looking at, up to 30 blocks away, for 25% of its maximum health.
identity_concealment_ability: Hide an identity. Use it on the player you are looking at, or on yourself if you are looking at no one, and their name tag disappears and they are removed from the player list for everyone. Use it again on the same player to restore them.
internal_underworld_ability: Keep an underworld inside you. Capture mode lets you right-click undead mobs, spirits and ghost Beyonders to imprison their souls. Capturing a ghost Beyonder uses up a matching Beyonder characteristic. Capture succeeds 55% of the time plus 5% for each Sequence number: 80% at Sequence 5, 55% at Sequence 0. A ghost that escapes disperses and gives the characteristic back. You can hold 5 souls at Sequence 5, rising to 53 at Sequence 0. Release brings out one chosen soul (or all of them) to fight for you, and Recall pulls them back in.
lesser_concealment_ability: Conceal yourself or a creature you are looking at, which protects them from divination. Using it again on someone already concealed removes it. The concealment lasts 15 minutes at Sequence 4, 30 minutes at Sequence 3, 1 hour at Sequence 2, 100 minutes at Sequence 1 and 130 minutes at Sequence 0, and it grows stronger as you advance.
luck_perception_ability: A toggled sense that shows your own luck and the luck of up to 48 nearby creatures within 24 blocks. It cannot read creatures that are much stronger than you, Wheel of Fortune Beyonders stronger than you, or targets hidden by Visionary powers. It costs no spirituality.
mythical_creature_form_ability: Take your mythical creature form. You grow to almost three times your size and your Beyonder power rises to 110% at Sequence 4, then 115%, 120%, 125% and 135% at Sequence 0. Enemies within 100 blocks who look at you and are weaker than you lose sanity and may begin losing control. A Visionary in this form can fly, and a Tyrant calls lightning down on those who look at it. At Sequences 4 and 3 the form is a strain: it drains your own sanity, very quickly at Sequence 4 and more slowly at Sequence 3. It ends if you change dimension. Usable even while your other abilities are disabled.
nation_of_the_dead_ability: Turn the land around you into a nation of the dead for 85 seconds, 35 blocks in every direction. Every enemy inside gets Wither II, Slowness III and Weakness II, and players are plunged into darkness. Each second they also lose 3% of their maximum health, ignoring armor, plus 0.5% for every Sequence they are below you. Enemies two or more Sequences weaker die immediately. Anything that dies inside rises as a skeleton that fights for you. The domain ends early if a stronger holy purification reaches it.
pale_eye_ability: A toggled gaze. Several times a second, the creature you look at within 25 blocks takes damage and gets Blindness II and Slowness III. A creature two or more Sequences weaker than you dies instantly under the gaze.
restruction_ability: Raise an army of the dead: 8 skeletons and 8 zombies (more as your power grows), each in iron armor with three times normal health and attack damage. They fight for you for 45 seconds. Summoning again replaces the old army, and Release dismisses it.
soul_control_ability: Seize the soul of a creature within 20 blocks. It cannot affect anyone stronger than you, and anyone two or more Sequences weaker dies at once. Against an equal target you have a 25% chance to kill it, and against a target one Sequence weaker a 50% chance. Two Sequence 0 Beyonders cannot kill each other this way. If the target resists, it still loses 20% of its maximum health and 40% sanity.
spirit_channeling_ability: Call a spirit into yourself. The call succeeds 50% of the time, or 75% at Sequence 6 and stronger, and gives you either a Frost Ghost or an Earth Spirit, each with its own techniques. Frost Ghost: Frozen Domain spreads an expanding ring of frost over 3 seconds that roots and slows enemies who are not stronger than you. Glacial Aegis blocks the next hit you take within 10 seconds. Earth Spirit: Stone Restrainment pins a creature within 20 blocks in stone and grinds it for about 4 seconds. Earthen Fist launches two stone fists forward. Quicksand turns the ground around a target into sinking sand for 10 seconds. Earth Heal restores 10% of your maximum health. Release the spirit to call another.
spirit_communication_ability: Speak with the spirit world. It includes Danger Premonition, Structure Divination and Player Divination, plus Spectral Bind: a creature within 20 blocks that is not stronger than you is held in place, frozen and weakened for about 3 seconds (longer as your power grows).
spirit_vision_ability: A toggled sight that shows the spirit body of the world. You gain night vision, every creature within 30 blocks glows through walls, and you see details of what you look at. Malice seeds planted in others show up as black outlines. Looking at a Beyonder far stronger than you, who is not your ally, can make you start losing control.
spirit_world_traversal_ability: Step between the Overworld and the Spirit World at the matching location, landing on a safe surface. If you would arrive above empty air, a block is placed under your feet. While you hold the ability in the Spirit World, it shows the matching Overworld coordinates.
undying_seal_ability: Places a seal on you for 60 seconds. It is meant to suppress the harmful side effects of sealed artifacts, but the code that would apply this is currently commented out, so in this version the seal has no effect beyond its activation message and visuals.
word_of_spirit_ability: Call out the spirit of a creature within 25 blocks that is not stronger than you, Spirit Calling it for 3 seconds: it is rooted in place, cannot jump or use items, and all damage it takes ignores armor. The ability fails inside a stronger purification area.
zombie_disguise_ability: A toggled disguise: you take the shape of a zombie and gain +28 max health, +6 attack damage and Resistance I. It drops automatically inside a stronger purification area.
